lincoln1865.name: Lincoln is shot
lincoln1865.what: President Abraham Lincoln was shot at Ford's Theatre in Washington on the evening of 14 April 1865 and died the next morning.

custer1876.name: Custer falls at the Little Bighorn
custer1876.what: Lieutenant Colonel George Armstrong Custer and about 260 men of the 7th Cavalry were killed at the Little Bighorn on 25 June 1876, in Montana Territory, far from any telegraph.

titanic1912.name: The Titanic sinks
titanic1912.what: RMS Titanic struck an iceberg late on 14 April 1912 and sank in the early hours of 15 April; news came ashore by wireless.

pearl1941.name: Pearl Harbor is attacked
pearl1941.site_name: Pearl Harbor, Oahu, Territory of Hawaii
pearl1941.what: Japanese aircraft attacked the US Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor on the morning of Sunday 7 December 1941; the news was broadcast on radio that afternoon.
